items.name: Heart Container - Phantom Ganon
items.desc:
The Boss Key opens the door at the back of the rotating room in the basement; go up the stairs and you'll reach the room of paintings. Phantom Ganon rides his horse into a painting and several riders come out: the real one makes hoofbeat sounds and opens a purple portal when he reaches the frame.

When the real one comes out, **shoot him with an arrow or hit him with the Hookshot**; three arrows will knock him off his horse. Then send his energy balls back at him with your sword or an empty Bottle until one hits and he falls; hit him and repeat until he's finished.

items.name: Time Block room
items.desc:
At the top of the stairs in the main hall, the door on the right opens with a Small Key and leads to the big lava room. On its left side there's a Time Block at the top of a wall: stand on the platform right in front of it, **step onto the engraved slab on the floor and play the Song of Time**. The block will come down and you can climb it to the door above.

Inside, shield yourself from the tiles that fly at you and finish off the Like Like: if it grabs you, it steals your Hylian Shield (you get it back when you beat it). Then knock the Gold Skulltula down from the wall.
items.hint: As you enter the big lava room, keep an eye on your left.

items.name: Wall in the boulder maze
items.desc:
This Gold Skulltula hides behind a stretch of wall in the rolling boulder maze. You get there by climbing the metal grate; from there, stick to the outer wall, dodging the rolling boulders, until you reach a cracked stretch of rock at the end of a passage, very close to a Goron's cell.

That stretch is plainly visible, so there's no need to feel around: **set a Bomb or a Bombchu against it** and, in the tunnel that opens behind it, knock down the Gold Skulltula. Take the chance to free the Goron in the cell next door.

items.name: Grate behind the Scarecrow
items.desc:
When you leave the room with the wall of fire that chases you, the door at the top takes you back to the boulder maze, this time from above. Stand on the platform right in front of the door and **play the Scarecrow's Song so Pierre appears on the high platform**.

Hookshot over to him and, from there, shoot the target next to it, on a platform that rises on its own like an elevator. Go through the door and climb the grates: as soon as you reach the top, the Gold Skulltula waits on the wall and you knock it down with the Hookshot.
items.hint: The Scarecrow's Song is composed as a child and as an adult at Lake Hylia.

items.name: Octagonal room at the top
items.desc:
Climb to the top of the grate you reach with the scarecrow, the one with this area's other Gold Skulltula, and go through the door at the top. It opens onto a big octagonal room full of lava, with a platform of three chests ringed by fire.

Just look to the right as you walk in to find it: **it's on the wall, a few steps from the door**, next to the lava. Kill it with the Hookshot and grab the token.
items.hint: Next to the one on the grate.

items.name: Behind the entrance hall statue
items.desc:
Save this one for last, once you have the Megaton Hammer and the last Small Key, the one from the Goron in the Time Block room past the hammer. That Goron tells you there's a secret door behind the three-block stone statue at the entrance: on the right side of the entrance hall, **smash the statue with the hammer** and open the door with the key.

In the first room, kill the Torch Slugs to open the next one. In the second, guard against the flying tiles, defeat the Like Like, and break the pile of rocks hiding the Gold Skulltula with the hammer.
items.hint: Smash the statue in the entrance hall and the pile of rocks with the hammer.

items.name: Heart Container - Volvagia
items.desc:
Volvagia pokes its head out of the holes in the platform: as soon as it does, **hit it with the Megaton Hammer and finish with your sword or the hammer itself** while it's stunned. When it takes flight, dodge its flames and the falling rocks by watching their shadows.

Once you beat it, the Heart Container appears next to the blue warp.
items.hint: You can only hurt it when it pokes its head out of the lava.

items.name: Next to the basement grate
items.desc:
With the temple's water at its lowest, use a Small Key to open the door at the base of the central pillar. Inside, play Zelda's Lullaby in front of the Triforce symbol to raise the water, put on the Iron Boots and sink through the hole in the floor to the basement room.

**Hit the crystal switch high on the wall with the Hookshot**: several enemies appear. Kill them, take off the boots to float up to the chest ledge, and pull down the Gold Skulltula on the wall, next to the grate, with the Hookshot.

items.name: Whirlpool river
items.desc:
After the fight with Dark Link, climb the stairs behind the Longshot chest and, in the next room, drop down the grated shaft. Follow the flooded tunnel until you come out into an underground river with whirlpools, and stay clear of them, because they suck you in.

In the whirlpool area, **put on the Iron Boots and walk along the bottom**, dodging the currents. The Gold Skulltula is above the water, high on the rock wall: aim up with the Longshot, which kills it and brings you the token.
items.hint: Watch for the Skulltula above the water.

items.name: Inside the central pillar
items.desc:
With Zelda's Lullaby, lower the temple's water to its lowest or middle level and go through the door at the base of the central pillar. Inside, on the ground floor, Longshot onto the target on the wall to reach a ledge halfway up.

From there, **look high up the wall**: that's where the Gold Skulltula is, and the same Longshot kills it and brings you the token. You don't need to raise the pillar's water first, but you can climb as needed.

items.name: Rolling boulder waterfall
items.desc:
In the north basement, reached with the Longshot, cross the Tektite room and the block puzzle room, and in the next one step on the switch and hop across the geysers to the other door. Behind it is a channel where boulders roll down from a waterfall, right next to the Boss Key room.

Take cover from the boulders in the side corridor, where a Shell Blade is waiting, and from there **look toward the waterfall, to the west**: the Gold Skulltula is on that wall. The Longshot reaches it without getting close and brings you the token.

items.name: Behind the cracked wall underwater
items.desc:
This Gold Skulltula is in a room on the east side of the first floor. With the water at the middle level, after playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the Triforce in the central pillar, put on the Iron Boots and go down the flooded east corridor to a cracked wall underwater: **break it with Bombs or the Megaton Hammer**.

Behind it is a room with enemies. The Skulltula is on a mosaic on the wall, next to the stairs and at sword height: knock it down with a sword strike and pick up the token.
items.hint: You need Bombs and the water at the middle level.

items.name: Heart Container - Morpha
items.desc:
With the Boss Key and the water at its highest, go up to the third floor (3F) and Longshot onto the target on the golden column on the north side. Climb the stairs and head up the water-filled ramp, dodging the spike traps sliding down.

Step on the platforms in the center to make Morpha appear and **get back to the outer edge of the room right away, away from the water**, because its tentacles grab you. Pull its nucleus out with the Longshot, hit it with your sword and, after the fight, pick up the Heart Container before stepping into the blue warp.

items.name: Invisible scythe room
items.desc:
In the big chasm room, after crossing with the Hover Boots to the Stalfos platform and defeating it, turn left and activate the Lenses of Truth: a path of invisible platforms to a door appears.

On the other side is the round room of pots, with scythes you can only see with the Lenses. Dodge them, shoot down the Fire Keese with the bow and finish off the Like Like with your sword: **clearing the room opens the door to a small room with the Gold Skulltula on the wall**, within sword reach.
items.hint: The alcove that opens also holds two chests, one of them invisible.

items.name: Wall of the cell corridor
items.desc: In the room with spikes falling from the ceiling, the Lenses of Truth reveal a block hidden in the wall: drag it under the spikes as an umbrella and climb onto it to reach the upper part. **The Gold Skulltula is high on the wall of the cell corridor**, and from the walkway the Hookshot reaches it.
items.hint: Climb onto the block to reach it from the walkway.

items.name: Pit in the fan corridor
items.desc:
Past the giant skull pot room, where a bomb thrown into the skull drops a Small Key, go on to the next room: use the Lenses of Truth to find the target on the ceiling, Hookshot up to the upper level and open the locked door there.

Behind it is the fan corridor. Put on the Iron Boots so the wind doesn't blow you away and go on to the pit with the grates: **the Gold Skulltula is on the pit wall**. Lean over the edge and reach it with the Hookshot, which brings you the token.
items.hint: With the Iron Boots, the wind can't blow you away.

items.name: High ledge in the boat room
items.desc:
As soon as you enter the boat room, pull the block on the left and push it along the groove in the floor to the wooden walkway, then climb up it. The Gold Skulltula is on the wall of a grated ledge next to it.

You have to **play the Scarecrow's Song on the walkway and Longshot onto Pierre**: it drops you on the ledge, next to the Skulltula, and you knock it down with your sword.
items.hint: You'll need to know the Scarecrow's Song to get up there.

items.name: Inside the giant skulls
items.desc:
When the boat sinks, burn the web over the door with a Fire Arrow and cross the Floormaster room with the Lenses of Truth to the door with the Sheikah eye.

Inside are the giant skulls. Climb the ladder to the balcony and **throw bombs into the skulls**: when the second one bursts, the Gold Skulltula Token drops out.
items.hint: The door on the shore is covered by a web: burn it with a Fire Arrow.

items.name: Heart Container - Bongo Bongo
items.desc:
In the fight, put on the Hover Boots so you don't bounce on the drum and **stun Bongo Bongo's hands with arrows or the Hookshot**. Then, with the Lenses active, shoot its eye and hit it with your sword.

When it's over, it leaves you the Heart Container.

items.name: Metal fence in the Keese room
items.desc:
As a child, you get in by talking to Nabooru and squeezing through the small hole in the entrance hall.

Further on, you reach the room with the Keese and the Wallmaster. Collect the Silver Rupees so the fence lowers and becomes a bridge: on the other side, **the Gold Skulltula is on the wire mesh of the right wall**. The Boomerang kills it and brings you the token.
items.hint: With the five Silver Rupees, the fence lowers and becomes a bridge.

items.name: Floor of the big statue room
items.desc:
Once you reach the room with the big statue, go down the side stairs to the lower floor and go around behind the statue.

In the narrow passage between its side and the wall, on the east side, **the Gold Skulltula is on the wall, at floor level**. One sword strike is enough to defeat it and pick up the token.

items.name: Above the staircase door
items.desc:
In the child's part of the temple, the block room is solved by moving the block with the sun face into the beam of light: a chest appears with a Small Key, the one for the chained door at the top of the next staircase. As you go through the door to that staircase, you can already hear the Skulltula.

Don't go up without looking back: turn around and you'll see it **above the door you just came through**. As a child, the Boomerang kills it and brings you the token, and as an adult the Hookshot does the same.
items.hint: Before the Iron Knuckle fight.

items.name: Behind the Time Block in the rolling boulder room
items.desc:
The adult part of the temple starts by shoving aside the big block in the entrance hall with the Silver Gauntlets. In the round room that follows, kill the Beamos (one Bombchu is enough) and hit the crystal switch on the ceiling with the Hookshot to open the doors.

The door on the right leads to the rolling boulder room. Dodge them until you reach the two Time Blocks in the recesses in the wall: the first hides nothing, but **play the Song of Time next to the second** and, when it moves aside, it reveals the Gold Skulltula at the back of its recess. Kill it with your sword and pick up the token.
items.hint: The block only moves one space, it doesn't disappear.

items.name: Northwest ledge of the statue room
items.desc:
The Gold Skulltula is on the high northwest ledge of the big goddess statue room, in the corner where a scarecrow appears.

As an adult, Longshot onto the target on the statue's wrist to climb onto its palm. From there, **play the Scarecrow's Song**: the scarecrow appears on top of the ledge and you can Longshot onto him. Up there, the Skulltula is on the floor next to him; kill it with your sword and pick up the token.
items.hint: Play the Scarecrow's Song from the statue's palm.

items.name: Heart Container - Twinrova
items.desc:
Against Twinrova, first reflect Koume's fire back at Kotake and Kotake's ice at Koume.

When they merge, **absorb three shots of the same element in a row and fire them at Twinrova**; when she falls, hit her with your sword. The Heart Container appears in the center of the platform.
items.hint: The Boss Key calls for Zelda's Lullaby, the bow and the Hookshot.

items.name: Left room off the central area
items.desc:
You need the Lenses of Truth, found in the basement, and a Small Key. With the Lenses on, hidden chests appear in alcoves in the well's walls, and one of them holds a key.

You enter the central area through the false wall opposite the entrance, and you have to go around the X on the floor, which is a hole. **Open the locked door on the left**, kill the Deku Baba in the middle of the room and look for the Gold Skulltula high on the wall, above a niche with candles: the Boomerang knocks it down and comes back with the token.
items.hint: There are two more keys in hidden alcoves in the entrance corridor.

items.name: High corner of the pit room
items.desc:
The locked door on the right of the central area, which you enter through the false wall opposite the entrance, leads to a room with Keese and a big pit. You need a Small Key, like the one from the coffin in the Gibdo room, and the Lenses of Truth.

Kill the Keese and **put on the Lenses to see the Gold Skulltula in a high corner, next to a torch**. Use the Boomerang to catch it.
items.hint: You need a key and the Lenses of Truth.

items.name: Like Like room
items.desc:
Follow the outer corridor that rings the center of the well to the northeast corner, where there's a door with a sign warning: "Watch your step!" Heed it, because right below is a trap that drops you to the bottom if you don't avoid it.

The next room has hidden holes in the floor, so **put on the Lenses of Truth and cross while watching where you step**.

Take out the Fire Keese with the Boomerang and blow up the Beamos with a bomb. The door on the other side leads to the Like Like room: once you beat it, the Gold Skulltula is on the back wall, between two torches, within Boomerang range, and it brings you the token too.
items.hint: Watch your step!

items.name: Spinning blade room
items.desc:
Kill the Freezards in the first room to open the grate and go on to the big round room with the spinning ice blade.

**Find the corner with the ice stalagmites, the one with the hidden Silver Rupee**: the Gold Skulltula is up on the wall, between the sheets of ice and above a stalagmite. Kill it with the Hookshot.
items.hint: The Silver Rupees open the Blue Fire room.

items.name: Compass room
items.desc:
Collect the Silver Rupees in the spinning blade room to open the way to the map room and fill a bottle with Blue Fire there. Go back to the blade room and melt one of its two red ice walls with it, the one leading to a corridor with spike traps.

At the end is the Compass room, full of stalagmites. Kill the Ice Keese and **look high up the back wall, next to a block of red ice**: that's where the Gold Skulltula is. Use the Hookshot to get it.

items.name: Ice block room
items.desc: In the room where you have to push an ice block, kill the Ice Keese and turn back toward the entrance: **the Gold Skulltula is high on the wall, to the left of the door as you come in**. It's easier to spot from the stone pillars; bring it down with the Hookshot from the floor and pick up the token.

items.name: Great Fairy: Double Defense
items.desc:
You reach the outside of Ganon's Castle from the ruined Hyrule Castle Town, and its dead-end path on the right ends where the Spin Attack fountain was when you were a child. Now a black stone pillar with golden engravings blocks the entrance: **lift it with the Golden Gauntlets**, which you get from the castle's Shadow Trial.

Inside, play Zelda's Lullaby from the Triforce emblem and toss the 500 Rupees she asks for as an offering into the fountain. The Great Fairy of Courage doubles your defense: your hearts get a gold border and you take half the damage.
items.hint: She asks for a 500-Rupee offering; the pillar at the entrance is removed with the Golden Gauntlets.

items.name: The seven lost Cuccos
items.desc:
The Cucco Lady, by the pen, has let seven of them escape; if you bring them back as a child, she gives you an Empty Bottle: **pick up each Cucco and throw it into the pen**. If you talk to her, she tells you how many are missing and gives you hints; the ones in the pen stay put even if you go into the houses.

One is right beside her, another near the entrance, another by the Death Mountain gate and another behind the fence of the House of Skulltula. The fifth is in a crate you break by rolling into it; the last two are in the fenced area behind the Potion Shop, which you reach by gliding.

items.name: Talon's Super Cuccos
items.desc:
First of all, you need to wake Talon, who's asleep at Hyrule Castle, with the Cucco that hatches from the Weird Egg, so he goes back to Lon Lon Ranch. At the ranch, enter his house during the day: at night, Talon is asleep.

For 10 Rupees he challenges you to **find his three Super Cuccos among all the Cuccos in the room** in 30 seconds: pick up Cuccos and he'll tell you when you get one right. If you pull it off, the first time he gives you a bottle of Lon Lon Milk.
items.hint: A game costs 10 Rupees.

items.name: Ruto's letter
items.desc:
At the bottom of Lake Hylia, near the exit of the underwater tunnel that comes from Zora's Domain, there is a bottle with a letter from Princess Ruto. As a child you can only get that deep with the Silver Scale, the prize from the diving game in Zora's Domain.

Next to the stone pillars sticking out of the water, **dive to the bottom and grab the bottle**.
items.hint: You can also reach the lake by diving from Zora's Domain.

items.name: The Poe Collector
items.desc:
As an adult, the old guard house at the entrance to Hyrule Castle Town is the Poe Collector's shop. For each Big Poe he pays you 30 Rupees and adds 100 points, and when you reach 500 points, with the fifth one, he gives you an Empty Bottle. If you keep going to 1000, he gives you a Huge Rupee, the gold one, worth 200 Rupees.

Big Poes appear around Hyrule Field when you ride Epona and jump one of the haunted fences: **shoot them down with arrows from horseback and catch each soul in an Empty Bottle**.
items.hint: He pays 30 Rupees for each Big Poe; the bottle comes at 500 points.

items.name: The potion shopkeeper's bug
items.desc:
In Hyrule Castle Town, enter the Potion Shop, in the building next to the path that leads up to the Temple of Time. The shopkeeper has let a bug get away: tell him you'll help and he'll give you an Empty Bottle to catch it with.

Equip the bottle and **catch the bug as it scurries across the shop floor**. As thanks, he fills it with a Red Potion, and the bottle is yours to keep.

items.name: Torch chest
items.desc:
Behind the waterfall on the bottom floor of Zora's Domain, a chest with the piece appears when, as a child, you light all its torches at the same time: light a Deku Stick on one of the torches in King Zora's chamber.

Go down and **light the one at the foot of the stairs first**, which doesn't go out, then the four short-lived ones, using each torch to relight the stick. They're the one in front of the Zora Shop, the one at the pond with the circle of rocks, and the two behind the waterfall, which you reach by hugging the wall.
items.hint: Din's Fire helps with the ones behind the waterfall.

items.name: Rooftop chest
items.desc:
The chest is on the highest rooftop of Gerudo's Fortress, up against the rock wall, across a gap. From the inner corridors, a ladder **next to your cell** takes you out onto a rock ledge above the rooftops; follow it to the edge from which you can see the chest.

From there, **aim the Longshot at the chest** to reach the loot.
items.hint: Use the Longshot to reach the chest.

items.name: Reward for 50 Skulltulas
items.desc: With 50 Gold Skulltula Tokens, go back to the House of Skulltula and **talk to the cursed rich man** to get the Piece of Heart.
items.hint: You need 50 Gold Skulltula Tokens.

items.name: Ruined archway
items.desc:
As an adult, the right-hand path outside Ganon's Castle, the one that leads to the Great Fairy's Fountain, passes under a ruined stone archway that used to be the entrance to Hyrule Castle.

**Go through the archway and turn around**: the Gold Skulltula is high up on its back face, out of your sword's reach. Take it down with the Hookshot.

items.name: Broken pedestal in the Royal Family's Tomb
items.desc:
In the Graveyard, enter the Royal Family's Tomb by playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce and go on to the last room, the one with the stone monument that teaches the Sun's Song.

There, above the green liquid, is a broken pedestal with the thought of a fairy who can't remember the melody carved into the monument and wants to hear it again so she won't forget it. **Play the Sun's Song next to the mark.**
items.hint: Play the Sun's Song next to the mark.

items.name: Spirit Temple stairway
items.desc: In the Desert Colossus, on the ledge where you get the Silver Gauntlets, between the two torch stands, the thought is on the low wall at the edge. The fairy says the view is breathtaking, but she can't stand such dry air and wishes a good downpour would come. Playing the Song of Storms here restores your magic and your health.
items.hint: Play the Song of Storms in front of the mark.

items.name: Ice tunnel next to the Compass room
items.desc: In the Ice Cavern, once you have the Compass, fill a bottle with the Blue Fire in that area and melt the block of red ice next to it. Follow the frozen tunnel behind it, the one leading to the spike trap corridor and the ice block room: you'll see this Fairy Thought on its wall. The fairy's wings are frosted over and she'd give anything to spend a little while in the sun. **Play the Sun's Song next to the mark.**
items.hint: Play the Sun's Song next to the mark.

items.name: Pot alcove on the west shore
items.desc: At Lake Hylia, follow the west shore south almost to the end: this thought is in an alcove in the rock wall, with pots, sacks, and barrels. The fairy says her secret for playing hide-and-seek is a spot the other fairies can't throw or break. **Break the pots in the alcove**: a fairy comes out of one, and there are a few Rupees too.
items.hint: Break the pots in the alcove: a fairy is hiding in one.

items.name: Ruins by the drawbridge
items.desc: Leave Hyrule Castle Town across the drawbridge and head east to the knoll overlooking the river: among the ruins of a moss-covered stone wall is the first Fairy Thought, and Navi takes the chance to explain what they are. The fairy says that when something falls on someone from a tree, it's no accident: it's her, hiding things in the branches. **Roll into tree trunks** to shake loose whatever they hold; the pine next to it drops a Blue Rupee.
items.hint: Roll into the trees: sometimes something falls from the branches.

items.name: Chest cave by Gerudo Valley
items.desc: In the west of Hyrule Field, in the arid stretch leading to Gerudo Valley, there's a shallow cave in the northern rock face with a chest inside. The fairy who left her thought here tells the kid in the pointy hat that the treasure is for him and that she didn't lock it. As an adult you're too late: the chest is open and empty. **Come back as a child and open the chest**, which then does hold a Piece of Heart.
items.hint: Come back as a child and open the chest in the cave.

items.name: Gossip Stone grotto south of the ranch
items.desc: Southeast of Lon Lon Ranch, next to a small pond, a ring of bushes covers a grotto that opens with a Megaton Hammer strike in the center. Inside there's a Skulltula hanging on the wall above a wooden crate, and a Gossip Stone, and the thought is on the rock wall. The fairy found a shiny golden bug here, but the pest on the wall pounced on her before she could catch it. **Finish off the wall Skulltula as a child and, as an adult, roll into the wooden crate beneath it to break it**: inside is the golden bug, a Gold Skulltula.
items.hint: Break the wooden crate under the Big Skulltula.

items.name: Tree by the Business Scrub's hole
items.desc: Leave Hyrule Castle Town across the drawbridge and head east along the strip of grass between the wall and the river: this thought is on a tree right against the wall and, a few steps away, there's a hole with a Business Scrub who only sells to those who know the password. The fairy says she finally figured it out, and that it wasn't "Not bad at all..." or "I'll make the dishbursement." As an adult he has nothing left, so **go as a child and tell him "Sell somethin', will ya?"**: he'll sell you a Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees.
items.hint: Say "Sell somethin', will ya?" to the Business Scrub in the hole next door.

items.name: Ruins by the ranch fence
items.desc: In Hyrule Field, go around the outside of Lon Lon Ranch to its southwest corner: right against the wooden fence are the ruins of an ivy-covered brick wall, and the thought is at the bottom, on the face of the wall. The fairy says she loves the view of the field from there, by night and by day, and that she'd like to switch from one to the other without having to wait. **Play the Sun's Song** and she'll restore your health and magic.
items.hint: Play the Sun's Song to switch from day to night.

items.name: Rock nook in northwest Hyrule Field
items.desc: At the far northwest of Hyrule Field, by the river, there's a nook in the rock with barrels, sacks and a table, and this thought is on the wall at its entrance. The fairy says Peahats scare her because they're huge, put down roots and act like they own the field, but that, like any plant, they can't stand fire. **Burn the Peahats with Din's Fire**.

items.name: Wall of the ranch garden
items.desc: In Lon Lon Ranch, go around behind the house and the stable to the garden: the thought is on the ivy-covered brick wall, among some crates, barrels and a wooden cart. The fairy says the little tune that boy plays is very pretty and has the cows going crazy. It's Epona's Song, but playing it next to the mark does nothing: **play it to a cow** and she'll give you Lon Lon Milk.
items.hint: Play Epona's Song to a cow.

items.name: Coffin in the Gibdo room
items.desc: In the Bottom of the Well, go down to B1 and enter the Gibdo room, the one with the web-wrapped coffins, which you clear by burning them with a Deku Stick lit at the torches. This Fairy Thought is on the side of one of the standing coffins: the fairy misses that man's song about going "around and around" and wishes someone around here knew it. **Play the Song of Storms next to the coffin** to restore magic and health.
items.hint: Play the Song of Storms next to the coffin.

items.name: Leaf circle near Goron City
items.desc: Climbing Death Mountain Trail, a few steps from the entrance to Goron City, there's a rock ledge on the right with a hole in the ground with a plant in it, and on the wall beside it, this thought. The fairy says that on calm days the leaves on the ground dance slowly in circles, but on stormy days they spin at full speed and look like they're about to fly off. **Play the Song of Storms on the circle** to get into the hole.
items.hint: Play the Song of Storms on the leaf circle.

items.name: Wall of the ceiling spike room
items.desc: On B3 of the Shadow Temple is the room where the hidden block shields you from the spikes falling from the ceiling. Past the cell with the Red Rupee chest, next to a hole in the wall, you'll see this Fairy Thought. The fairy says she loves places where the wind blows hard and **that this place could really use a good gust of wind**.

items.name: Business Scrub in the Crater
items.desc:
In the Crater, as a child, head west from the Death Mountain summit entrance, toward where the map marks the Great Fairy's Fountain. Next to a climbing net on the wall, a Business Scrub pops out of the ground and will try to attack you.

Get close while dodging its shots and hit it. When it gives up, talk to it: **it sells you the Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees**.
items.hint: As a child, it sells it to you for 100 Rupees after you hit it.

items.name: Ruins at the Royal Family's Tomb entrance
items.desc:
In the Graveyard, go up to the slab with the Triforce that opens the Royal Family's Tomb: this thought is among the broken stones of the entrance.

The fairy tells how she ended up at the bottom of a grave, how a horrifying monster came at her, and how it stopped chasing her when she sang a song that dazzled it, but she can't remember what it was called. **It's the Sun's Song: play it to paralyze the ReDeads.**
items.hint: The Sun's Song paralyzes ReDeads.

items.name: Ruins by the exit to Lake Hylia
items.desc:
At the southern tip of Hyrule Field, near the path down to Lake Hylia, there are some stone ruins among the trees: the thought is on the face of one of the pillars.

The fairy begs that no one ever swing a stick at a butterfly, and even less so without moving. **Hit a butterfly with a Deku Stick without moving from the spot: it turns into a Fairy.**
items.hint: Hit a butterfly with a Deku Stick: it turns into a Fairy.

items.name: Rock nook by the entrance to Zora's River
items.desc:
On the eastern edge of Hyrule Field, a little south of the entrance to Zora's River, there's a nook in the rock with barrels, a table, a bench and the remains of a campfire: the thought is on the rock wall.

The fairy loves laying out Rupees in pretty shapes. She hides them in pits and holes, and underwater too, and doesn't mind if someone takes them. **Look for Rupees laid out in shapes in pits, holes and underwater.**
items.hint: Look for Rupees laid out in shapes in pits, holes and underwater.

items.name: Rocks by the moat west of the drawbridge
items.desc:
Leave Hyrule Castle Town across the drawbridge and head west along the bank of the moat: across from the wall where the water pours out there are some big rocks, and this thought is next to them.

The fairy says no one will ever suspect she's hidden her whole fortune in a wooden crate.
items.hint: The fairy says she's hidden her whole fortune in a wooden crate.

items.name: Cart by the vegetable patch near Kakariko
items.desc:
In northeast Hyrule Field, not far from the way up to Kakariko Village, there's a wooden cart against a low stone wall: the thought is on its planks.

The fairy says the place looks lonely, as if there were nothing but weeds, but that if you look closely you'll see little ones scurrying around on the sly. **Go down to the vegetable patch: there are Bugs scurrying among the plants.**
items.hint: There are Bugs scurrying among the plants in the vegetable patch next door.
